pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarena brāhmaṇena saṅghassa payopānaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.6: Ye te bhikkhū appicchā…pe… te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti –
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.7: ‘‘kathañhi nāma bhikkhu saṅghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissatī’’ti…pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.8: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, bhikkhu, saṅghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ akāsīti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.11: kathañhi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, saṅghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissasi!
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.15: ‘‘na, bhikkhave, buddhaṃ vā dhammaṃ vā saṅghaṃ vā ārabbha davo kātabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.17: Atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya…pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.18: evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha –
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.21: Yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca surusurukārakaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
